title: Exclusive lottery licence (Queensland)
summary: The Lotteries Act 1997 (Qld) lets the lottery licence issued to the corporation be exclusive for a specified term.
direction_rationale: An exclusive licence keeps other lottery operators out.

marks.reason: An exclusive lottery licence keeps other operators out for its term.
